translations.web: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
translations.bsb: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
translations.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
